title: Grand Theft Auto V
description: About 32 hours of story for a typical player (HowLongToBeat): driving, flying, boating and cover shooting under strict fail conditions, three switchable characters and heist plans. No AI agent has reported passing a full story mission yet; the GTAGym benchmark tests sub-tasks, not whole missions.
clear_condition: Finish the story: pass any of the three final missions (The Third Way, Something Sensible, or The Time's Come).
timing: Run time from the 'Ludendorff, North Yankton' title to the end of the final mission.
rules: Story mode, unmodified game, any version (state Legacy or Enhanced). No cheat codes, trainers or taxi fast travel; do not use the skip offered after failing a mission three times. Mods that only read game state for the agent are allowed on the harness track and must be disclosed.
